evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing without identifying customer's two primary concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised or probed.

top_strength: Rep gathered detailed logistics information (floor, elevator, walking distance, special items, box count, drive time, destination property type) with reasonable follow-up probing and confirmed key details accurately.
coaching_note: Start every call with the quid pro quo framing (time-boxed promise + dependable quote), then ask the two-concerns question before any probing, and deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) while permission is still there — all three are missing from this call and are load-bearing for credibility and close rate.
